source.description: GrokBuild-native agent-model defaults. All roles use Grok models only; no external provider dependencies.

perf_notes.grok-4.5: Current GrokBuild frontier default for orchestration/reasoning. Prefer when available.
perf_notes.grok-3-mini-fast: Fastest Grok: 1.96s coding, 146t/s. Best for high-volume read-only agents (explorer).
perf_notes.grok-4.20-0309-non-reasoning: Fast reasoning-capable: 0.68s coding, 1.96s reasoning. Best for analysis/review.
perf_notes.grok-4.20-0309-reasoning: Deep reasoning: 6.3s, 163t/s. Best for planning, complex analysis.
perf_notes.grok-4.3: Prior frontier: 8.48s, 159t/s. Fallback for deep verification.
perf_notes.grok-build-0.1: Build agent: 3.72s, 150t/s. Good for coding tasks.
perf_notes.grok-composer-2.5-fast: Composer utility: preferred fast/coding path for GrokBuild.

explorer.role_rationale: Explore agent: Grok mini-fast for high-volume codebase search

librarian.role_rationale: Librarian agent: Grok mini-fast for external doc lookup

plan.role_rationale: Strategic planning: Grok 4.5 frontier primary; Grok 4.20 reasoning as availability fallback

metis.role_rationale: Metis pre-planning analysis: Grok 4.5 frontier reasoning

momus.role_rationale: Momus critical plan review: Grok 4.5 frontier for adversarial analysis

codex-ultrawork-reviewer.role_rationale: Final verification: Grok 4.5 frontier primary; Grok 4.3 as availability fallback

reasoning.role_rationale: General reasoning: Grok 4.5 is the GrokBuild frontier default; Grok 4.20 reasoning as availability fallback

coding.role_rationale: Coding role: Grok Composer primary; non-reasoning Grok as availability fallback

default.role_rationale: Default orchestrator (Sisyphus): Grok 4.5 primary at low effort for orchestration; Grok 4.20 reasoning as availability fallback

hephaestus.role_rationale: Hephaestus host coordination: Grok 4.5 high; Grok 4.20 reasoning as availability fallback

prometheus.role_rationale: Prometheus strategic planner: Grok 4.5 frontier primary; Grok 4.20 reasoning as availability fallback

multimodal-looker.role_rationale: Vision specialist: Gemini 3.1 Pro vision primary (topology vision); Grok 4.5 multimodal fallback

sisyphus.role_rationale: Sisyphus orchestrator: Grok 4.5 primary at low effort for orchestration; Grok 4.20 reasoning as availability fallback

atlas.role_rationale: Atlas todo-list orchestrator: Grok 4.5 frontier for task coordination

oracle.role_rationale: Oracle reasoning consultant: GPT-5.5 deep analysis primary (topology deep_oracle); Grok 4.5 frontier fallback

sisyphus-junior.role_rationale: Sisyphus-Junior: Grok 4.5 for lighter orchestration tasks

ultrabrain.role_rationale: Ultrabrain category: Grok 4.5 xhigh for maximum reasoning depth

deep.role_rationale: Deep category: Grok 4.5 for deep analysis tasks

quick.role_rationale: Quick category: Grok mini-fast for rapid responses

unspecified-low.role_rationale: Unspecified-low: Grok mini-fast for lightweight tasks

writing.role_rationale: Writing category: Grok mini-fast for content generation

visual-engineering.role_rationale: Visual-engineering: Gemini 3.1 Pro vision primary (topology vision); Grok 4.5 multimodal fallback

artistry.role_rationale: Artistry: Grok 4.5 multimodal for creative analysis

artistry-gen.role_rationale: Artistry production worker: Grok 4.5 for creative generation tasks

artistry-qa.role_rationale: Artistry QA inspector: Grok 4.5 for creative quality review

ulw.role_rationale: ULW loop surface: Grok 4.5 primary aligned with Sisyphus/Prometheus deep-work routing
